Name: Content Patcher Version for Rose's Interior
Author: VulgarJuice
Description:
This mod is just a Content Patcher Version of Roserish's Mod called "Rose's Interior".

Note:
I asked Roserish before posting this.
This mod is [b]not made[/b] by me. I only [b]edited it[/b] to be used for content patcher because some people didn't want to replace any xnb files.
Pictures used are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/Users/54670717]Roserish[/url].

If you like the mod please go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2715]Roserish's mod[/url] and give votes/endorsements there.
